messages:
natalie: Planning a minimal cutover tonight 01:00 UTC. Scope: api (header routing change), runtime (quant profile), router (split shim), console (feature flag flip). Goal: keep latency steady and avoid cache churn. Quick plan in the doc: https://go/runbooks/minimal-cutover.
ryan: +1. Suggest using an "accordion" traffic pattern: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with a 3m hold at each step. Smaller increments reduce sudden KV miss storms.
karen: I'll own runtime rollout and health checks. We'll apply quant-profile: fast-q-3 and pin model tag to serve-20240615. If kernel GC > 3x baseline or OOM spikes, we pause and revert.
clara: Router: I'll run the shim that keeps old headers accepted for 2 minutes post-split to prevent tokenization drift. Watching per-shard convergence and retry queues. Threshold: any shard lag > 45s -> pause.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduling deploy-1749901111-01 for 2024-06-15T01:00:00Z by @natalie. Stages: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Preflight: image sigs OK, schemas compatible, infra-lock applied.
ryan: API will roll by header: x-experiment: cutover-174990. We'll start with backend=canary and keep console in read-only UI mode until final.
karen: Health criteria: p95 latency delta <= +150ms, error-rate delta <= +0.7% absolute, CPU util on runtime nodes < 85%. If breached, we run rollback.
clara: Router rollback command (one-liner): `routerctl revert-split --id deploy-1749901111-01 --force`
deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks passed, lock token lock-1749901111 issued. Canary monitors configured: latency-check, error-rate-check, shard-convergence.
ops-oncall: I'll be on duty at 00:45 UTC and monitoring alerts. Please DM #oncall when you initiate api stage.
natalie: Added short emergency path: if runtime canary fails we immediately switch api header to route to fallback-model serve-20240501 and pin runtime back to fast-q-2. Command snippets added to runbook.
ryan: Also adding a 4-minute KV warming window between api -> runtime to let prefix cache stabilize. We'll only advance if cache-miss rate falls to baseline+10%.
karen: Rollback snippet for runtime: ```
# pin back
runtimectl set-profile --all fast-q-2
runtimectl pin-model --tag serve-20240501
```
clara: I'll keep an eye on router metrics: route-split convergence, 5xx per-route, retry-queue depth. If retry-queue depth > 500 in any shard, we pause.
natalie: Final timeline: 00:45 quiet window begins, 00:50 oncall ready, 00:58 final lock, 01:00 api start, 01:07 runtime start, 01:15 router start, 01:25 console flip. We'll run smoke tests after each major stage: `smoke-e2e --subset api,runtime`.
deploybot: deploybot: canary stage succeeded for api (10m). Proceed when owners ack.
ryan: Ack from api side, moving to runtime in ~30s.
karen: Runtime canary healthy at 5m. p95 +40ms, errors flat. Proceed to router.
clara: Router split at 20% applied. Watching shard convergence.
ops-oncall: Noted. No alerts so far.
natalie: If anyone hits manual rollback, call it and assign incident lead. Keep chat updates brief. Thanks team. :rocket:
